annotations.title: Combine clips into a finished video

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Extends a video draft (`id`) with more clips and image cards into ONE finished video, rendered by flayr and saved as a NEW linked draft (same brand, caption copied, credits merged, labelled variant:combined). Nothing is posted and the original is unchanged. Use it to show a finished print with painting/assembly clips before or after it. `segments` (2-8, in order) must include the video itself as { kind: "clip", contentId: id }; clips are Library videos (contentId) or uploads (storageId from upload_media) with inMs/outMs (or durationMs = the clip's full length); cards are images (contentId of a Library image or video thumbnail, or imageStorageId) with durationMs and optional text. `transition` cut|crossfade, `audio` keep|mute_extras|main_across. Max 60 min by default (long-form: cold open + trimmed recording + bumpers). Costs 25 Embers per started minute of output for the first 3 min, then 5 per further started minute by default (refunded on failure). Returns a jobId — poll get_job_status.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/content/{id}/combine.)

segments.description: In playback order. Must include this video ({ "kind": "clip", "contentId": "<id>" }).

contentId.description: clip: a Library video. card: a Library image, or a video (its thumbnail).

durationMs.description: clip: the source clip's full length (needed when outMs is omitted). card: how long it shows (1000-10000).

inMs.description: clip only: where the clip starts (default 0).

outMs.description: clip only: where the clip ends. Defaults to durationMs.

text.description: card only: one short line over the image.

name: combine_clips
title: Combine clips into a finished video
